market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: A drop to $20 from current ~$200 would require a >90% decline. Historically, such extreme drawdowns for major altcoins occur only during systemic crises like the FTX collapse. The 13-month window makes a repeat of such an event unlikely, so the true probability is lower than 9.5%.
evidence_points: SOL currently trades near $200; a $20 low implies a 90%+ crash, seen only during Black Swan events.
The resolution window of ~13 months limits the chance of a catastrophic altcoin wipeout absent an immediate systemic shock.
Market-implied 9.5% probability assigns significant weight to extreme tail risk that, while possible, appears overpriced relative to base rates.
